description: Reproducible CCEL Calvin Commentary ThML/XML source list (pilot subset). No raw XML is committed to git; fetch with scripts/build_commentary_database.py --calvin-fetch, which downloads each url and verifies raw_sha256 before use.
license: Public Domain (per each file's ThML DC.Rights)

sources.title: Commentary on Romans
sources.notes: Standard single-book commentary; clean chapter/verse-range structure. Used as the 'standard' pilot volume.

sources.title: Harmony of the Evangelists (Matthew, Mark, Luke) - Part 1
sources.notes: Gospel Harmony; div2 sections routinely link two or three passages (e.g. Matthew 1:1-17;Luke 3:23-38) in one section. Used as the 'complex hierarchy / multi-passage' pilot volume.
